script.es: El sabor de Europa, horneado hoy.
script.en: The taste of Europe, baked today.

parrafo.es: Tastes of Europe Bakery lleva años horneando pan, beigli y pasteles húngaros en Hollywood, FL. Sin azúcares artificiales, sin colorantes ni conservantes: solo recetas europeas de verdad, hechas a mano cada mañana.
parrafo.en: Tastes of Europe Bakery has spent years baking Hungarian bread, beigli and pastries in Hollywood, FL. No artificial sugars, no colors, no preservatives: just real European recipes, made by hand every morning.

hero.imagen_alt: Tastes of Europe Bakery storefront with red awning and Hungarian flag in the window, Hollywood, FL

parrafo_1.es: Tastes of Europe Bakery es una panadería europea en Hollywood, FL, especializada en recetas húngaras: pan artesanal, beigli de nuez y amapola, kifli, cozonac y challah. Todo se hornea en el local, sin azúcares artificiales, colorantes ni conservantes.
parrafo_1.en: Tastes of Europe Bakery is a European bakery in Hollywood, FL, specializing in Hungarian recipes: artisan bread, walnut and poppy seed beigli, kifli, cozonac and challah. Everything is baked in house, with no artificial sugars, colors or preservatives.

parrafo_2.es: Los clientes repiten lo mismo en Google: el pan siempre está fresco y la atención se siente como de familia. Cada sábado se hacen langos recién fritos de 10am a 4pm, la especialidad que más se extraña de Europa.
parrafo_2.en: Clients say the same thing over and over on Google: the bread is always fresh and the service feels like family. Every Saturday the bakery fries fresh langos from 10am to 4pm, the specialty that reminds people most of home.

texto.es: Pasa por 1811 Wiley St o llama al 786-356-6761 para preguntar por el pan y los pasteles del día.
texto.en: Stop by 1811 Wiley St or call 786-356-6761 to ask about the day's bread and cakes.

texto.es: El pan, el beigli y los pasteles se hornean a diario, sin azúcares artificiales ni conservantes.
texto.en: Bread, beigli and cakes are baked fresh every day, with no artificial sugars or preservatives.

texto.es: Pan artesanal, beigli de nuez o amapola, kifli, cozonac, challah o pastelería dulce del mostrador.
texto.en: Artisan bread, walnut or poppy seed beigli, kifli, cozonac, challah or sweet pastries from the counter.

texto.es: Cada sábado de 10am a 4pm se fríe langos fresco, la especialidad húngara más pedida.
texto.en: Every Saturday from 10am to 4pm, fresh langos comes out of the fryer, the most requested Hungarian specialty.

nota.es: Precios reales del mostrador. Panes y pasteles especiales se cotizan por encargo, llama y te damos el detalle.
nota.en: Real prices from the counter. Special breads and cakes are quoted on request, call and we will give you the details.

texto.es: El rollo tradicional húngaro, horneado entero y relleno de nuez o semilla de amapola.
texto.en: The traditional Hungarian roll, baked whole and filled with walnut or poppy seed.

texto.es: Hojaldres rellenos y espolvoreados con azúcar glass, horneados cada mañana.
texto.en: Filled puff pastries dusted with powdered sugar, baked fresh every morning.

texto.es: El clásico pastel húngaro de capas con cobertura de caramelo.
texto.en: The classic layered Hungarian cake with a caramel glaze.

texto.es: Galletas rellenas de mermelada de albaricoque o cereza, al estilo austriaco.
texto.en: Jam-filled cookies with apricot or cherry filling, Austrian style.

pie.es: También preparamos cozonac, challah, kifli y pan de cada día. Pregunta por el menú completo en el mostrador.
pie.en: We also make cozonac, challah, kifli and fresh daily bread. Ask about the full menu at the counter.

items.quote: Really enjoyed visiting Tastes of Europe Bakery! Everything tasted fresh and homemade, from the pastries to the breads and desserts. The bakery has that authentic European feel, with lots of great options and rich flavors that remind you of home.

The lovely lady who works at the bakery is so nice. The bread is always fresh and delicious, reminds me of being back home in Europe. I went there earlier than their regular opening time of 8:00am, I was there at 7:40, but the kind lady let me in and served me. Lovely customer service.

Reminds me of my grandmother on my Dad's side, who was 100% Hungarian, and made a lot of the items available in the bakery. Nostalgia got me when I saw the poppy seed rolls and the fresh bread. Saturday is the day of all days to go, langos.

texto.es: Pregunta por el pan y los pasteles del día, o por un encargo especial.
texto.en: Ask about the day's bread and cakes, or about a special order.
